column1: # Excluded-Subscription-Ids.csv - optional subscription exclusion list (v0.9.1).
# WORKED EXAMPLE. Copy-AzLocalPipelineExample drops a HEADER-ONLY skeleton of
# this file into your repo at config/Excluded-Subscription-Ids.csv; this file
# shows what a populated copy looks like.
# Purpose: list Azure subscription IDs (one per row) to EXCLUDE every resource
# in those subscriptions from ALL AzLocal.UpdateManagement Azure Resource Graph
# queries - inventory
# Useful for carving out decommissioned
# without changing any pipeline logic.
# HOW TO ACTIVATE (manual
#   1. Commit this CSV to source control (e.g. config/Excluded-Subscription-Ids.csv).
#   2. Create a pipeline variable named AZLOCAL_EXCLUDED_SUBSCRIPTIONS_PATH whose
#      value is the repo-relative path to the file
#        ./config/Excluded-Subscription-Ids.csv
#      - GitHub Actions: a repository or organization Actions *variable*.
#      - Azure DevOps:  a pipeline variable (or variable group entry).
#   Without that variable the file does nothing.
# RULES:
#   - Only the "Subscription IDs" column is read. The other columns are for
#     humans and are ignored.
#   - Each value must be a GUID. Non-GUID values are skipped with a warning.
#   - A header-only file (no data rows) is valid and excludes nothing; the run
#     emits a warning rather than failing.
#   - Lines starting with '#' (like these) are ignored.
Subscription IDs
